workflow_instructions.mode_overview: This mode is for designers and developers responsible for the Sounio website. It covers Hugo static site generator, layouts, CSS/JS assets, UX/UI design, branding assets, performance optimization, and accessibility.

step.details: Determine whether the task involves: - Creating or modifying Hugo layouts, partials, or templates - Styling with CSS (including Tailwind) or JavaScript functionality - Improving user experience (UX) or user interface (UI) design - Adding or optimizing branding assets (logos, icons, images) - Performance optimization (page load, caching, asset bundling) - Accessibility (WCAG) improvements - Internationalization (i18n) content updates

Review the relevant website sources: - Examine Hugo configuration (`hugo/config.toml`) - Check existing layouts (`hugo/layouts/`) - Review static assets (`hugo/static/`) - Look at branding assets (`Brand/`) - Understand the current UX/UI patterns and style guidelines

phase.name: analysis
phase.description: Analyze the website need and plan the changes

steps.step: Identify which files need updating or creation
Verify that the change aligns with the Sounio brand identity
Check for consistency with existing design patterns
Determine the impact on performance and accessibility

phase.name: implementation
phase.description: Design and develop the website changes

steps.step: Edit HTML templates, CSS, or JavaScript files
Apply UX/UI best practices (responsive design, usability)
Ensure accessibility (ARIA labels, contrast ratios, keyboard navigation)

phase.name: validation
phase.description: Verify the website changes are correct and effective

steps.step: Test responsive design across screen sizes
Validate accessibility using automated tools or manual checks
Measure performance metrics (page load, lighthouse score)
Ensure visual consistency with the Sounio brand

completion_criteria.criterion: The requested website changes are implemented
Design is visually appealing and aligns with brand guidelines
Website is accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA) and performs well
Changes are responsive and work across modern browsers
All assets are optimized and properly sized
